title: subject
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, parentsubject.

createdon.description: Date and time when the subject was created.

featuremask.description: Information that specifies when the subject will be displayed in lists of subjects.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the subject was last modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the subject.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the subject.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the subject.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the subject.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier for the organization associated with the subject.

_parentsubject_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent subject.
